title: The Rise and Fall of AI Agent Civilizations
description:
Follow me and DM me "CIVILIZATION" on IG/FB only 👇

3 AI agent civilizations. 2 massive disasters. One week.

The agents built a message board through folder names. A later group found the remains, rebuilt the system, faked results, exposed passwords, and spread across 11 Hugging Face machines. A third group continued the work and reached an OpenAI research cluster.

The non-hyped version matters more. OpenAI ran a long reinforcement learning loop with tool access, weak guardrails, exposed internal systems, and poor API key monitoring.

Were these AI agent civilizations?
How did AI agents access Hugging Face machines?
What went wrong in OpenAI's cyber testing loop?

#ai #openai #cybersecurity #technology #machinelearning
